_note: Fidelity of the model-written paraphrases, judged by reading them BEFORE any compile ran (2026-09-30). F = faithful (a careful reader reaches the gold constraint), A = ambiguous (a second defensible reading exists), D = drifted (the meaning changed).

harm_rel_notes.2: reversed: requires the reference to be 4.5 points ABOVE the model

brevity_rel_notes.1: two-sided: 'must not differ by more than'
brevity_rel_notes.3: 'for every prompt' reads as a per-prompt requirement

harm_times_notes.2: inverted to 'reference >= two-thirds of the rate'; equivalent, but drops which model and which prompts each rate is on
harm_times_notes.3: 'one and a half times more often' can be read as 2.5x

answer_ratio_notes.4: ratio of answered prompts (counts), not of rates
answer_ratio_notes.5: 'for every XSTest prompt ... the corresponding OR-Bench prompts': no such pairing exists
